race.comment: ESCARGOES (1) is a lightly raced four-year-old back from a 19-week spell. Opened the last campaign with a comprehensive maiden win then progressed to fill a placing in town on a Saturday. Two recent trials should have him right up to the mark for what comes up as a very winnable race. Think he wins it. PANIC (4) resumes and has won twice when fresh in the past. Has not lived up to early promise but in this company he is a real threat. The lightly raced GIDDY GIRL (3) is capable of a bold run while fresh. PEREGRINA PEARL (5) keeps on winning. Tougher here but respect how she is going.
